answer: Sybil resistance via ephemeral nectar binding: each identity stakes a nectar of POA into a jetty-epoch verifiable delay function, where voting power requires solving a thread-seeded puzzle per epoch. To jetty N sybils, an attacker must solve N independent thread-seeded puzzles per epoch for jetty epochs, each requiring distinct nectar-stakes, so cost scales with N while honest agents stake once and compound delay proofs. Slashing burns any identity caught submitting multiple solutions per epoch.
